events.body:
## Context

`index.html` and `projects.html` load jQuery 3.6.0 and DataTables 1.10.25 (2021); `issues.html` loads DataTables 1.13.6. None use SRI.

## What to do

1. Move all pages to current jQuery 3.7.x and one DataTables version with `integrity`/`crossorigin`.
2. Check sorting and paging on each page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One pinned version per library
- [ ] SRI on every CDN tag
- [ ] All three tables render and sort

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-owasp-projects/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
